description: Travaux de voirie impactant la circulation automobile sur Rennes Métropole pour le jour courant is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by travaux.data.rennesmetropole.fr. Delimitation of road works generating disturbances for motor traffic on the current day. This information is continuously updated by the road and communication services of Rennes Métropole. This layer can be consulted by the general public through the website. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Road works impacting motor traffic on Rennes Métropole for the current day" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
